entities.name: Adam Królikiewicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adam Łukasz Królikiewicz was a Polish horse rider, major of Polish Army, who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. He was born in Lviv. He died in Konstancin-Jeziorna. He was a member of Polish Legions and fought in World War I.
